主要内容: The document titled 'a291506k.htm' is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, a Canadian financial institution, published on February 9, 2015. The filing includes a report on the issuance of Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series F, with an aggregate principal amount of $1,750,000,000, due on February 3, 2017. The filing incorporates legal opinions from Sullivan & Cromwell LLP and Norton Rose Fulbright Canada LLP regarding the validity of the notes under U.S. and Canadian law, as well as tax considerations. The document is part of the Bank’s registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-189888). The filing is signed by James Salem, Executive Vice-President and Treasurer of Royal Bank of Canada, on February 9, 2015.
